hens_rule_text: Raising chickens, rabbits or similar fowl and small animals is permitted, with the actual headcount set by Table No. 30-432 in the Zoning and Development Code; the specific number of hens in that table could not be read from available extracts.
permit_notes: One secondary source suggested Fontana may require a permit and pointed to the Fontana Police Department Animal Services team, but no permit process for keeping chickens was confirmed in the code text found.
setback_notes: Animals must be corralled, penned or caged at least 40 ft from any dwelling on the property, per a search-result extract of the zoning code.
coop_rules: Animals must be corralled, penned or caged; other keeping standards are in Table No. 30-432 and surrounding sections, not fully read.
zoning_notes: Rules sit in Chapter 30 (Zoning and Development Code) Sec. 30-432, referenced by the city's own Animal Municipal Code index as 'Fowl & Livestock 30-432(2)a.1' and 'Quantity of Animals 30-432(2)b'; animal slaughter for marketable products or private consumption is prohibited in all zoning districts.
hoa_note: Homeowners associations, deed restrictions and leases can be stricter than city law. Check yours before getting chickens.

sources.name: City of Fontana, Animal Municipal Code index page
Fontana Zoning and Development Code, Chapter 30 (Municode)

research_notes: The city's own Animal Municipal Code page (read directly) confirms the exact section numbers (30-432(2)a.1 for fowl and livestock, 30-432(2)b for quantity) but only links out rather than quoting text. Municode is region-blocked from this machine and the specific zoning code node with Table No. 30-432 was not located via search or Wayback, so the numeric hen cap, rooster rule and permit status are unconfirmed; the 40 ft setback and slaughter ban come from a single search-result extract, not directly verified text.
